description: In relay_error.rs, SmtpRelayError::is_transient() and is_permanent() each enumerate variants explicitly. The enum is #[non_exhaustive], so a new variant added in the future will not be caught by the compiler as unhandled in these methods — it will silently match the default false arm. A delivery attempt for a new error variant will appear as neither transient nor permanent, causing it to be dropped without retry or dead-letter. Fix: add a compile-time assertion or exhaustive match (remove the _ arm) in is_transient and is_permanent, using #[allow(unreachable_patterns)] only as a last resort. Alternatively, annotate the default arm with a todo! so new variants are caught at test time.
title: smtp: SmtpRelayError is_transient/is_permanent exhaustiveness gap
